result.reason: The clause does not require a pro-rata refund of prepaid fees and retains the original mutual 15-day termination right when no Statement of Work is outstanding, potentially allowing Vendor to terminate during a committed term and giving Company a shorter overlapping right. It also introduces payment for non-cancellable expenses, which is not required by the playbook and may impose an additional termination charge. The duplicative, inconsistent notice periods make the drafting unclear.
